title: Console: read the one lock read, word "closed" apart from "in approval", and save a closing header last (ADR-0162 item 4)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed · Source: ADR-0162 Execution item 4 (accepted by merge 972114df)

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：让记录页、列表和明细表格读统一的锁查询，已关闭的单据上编辑变灰、删除隐藏，并写明原因是「已关闭」。
- 用户会看到什么：打开一张已关闭的单据，不再看到可以点的编辑和删除；提示写的是「单据已关闭」，不是「审批中请等待」；一次保存里既改明细又把单据关闭时能成功。
- 不做会怎样：服务端照样会拒绝，但用户要点了保存才知道，而且提示会误说成「等待审批完成」。
- 顺序：排在统一锁查询那张卡之后。

## What happens

The console asks the approvals-family lock read. The grid keeps or drops Delete by `lockSource` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`), and the record page reads its lock through `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts`. Neither is told about closed states, so a closed document shows Edit and Delete, and the server's refusal is the user's first notice. Apps work around it with per-object `userActions` predicates.

The master-detail save writes the header first (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/masterDetailTx.ts`). Under ADR-0162 D4 a save that edits lines and closes the document must write the lines first: once the closing write has landed, the next write in the same unit of work meets a closed record.

## Expected

- The record page, the grid and the line grid ask the one lock read (item 2) and word the reason from `lockReason`: "in approval" and "closed" are different things to tell a user.
- On a locked record Edit is greyed. Delete is hidden where the read says `closed_state`, for either `lockSource`. Under `approval` the published rule stays: a record held on its own keeps Delete, a line of a held master does not.
- No per-object predicate is needed for it. `userActions` predicates stay display only and unchanged.
- The master-detail save orders a closing header write last, after its line writes.
- An action button stays as the app declares it: the lock read does not hide an action. An app's own "Reopen", "Void" or "Refund" action is how a closed document is changed.
- Strings in every locale the console carries.

## Done when

- [ ] A closed record: Edit greyed with the closed wording, Delete hidden, on the record page, in the grid and in the line grid of its master.
- [ ] A record held by an approval: unchanged from today, including Delete by `lockSource`.
- [ ] A record that is both closed and held reads as closed.
- [ ] A reader who may not see the state field still gets the closed wording, and the page shows neither the field nor its value.
- [ ] One save that edits lines and sets the closing state lands whole. A test pins the write order.
- [ ] No console code path asks the approvals-family lock read for the edit and delete affordances. The record page's approvals panel keeps its own `lock`.
- [ ] Browser-verified on the showcase's paid invoice (after item 3) or a fixture app, with screenshots in the PR.

Category ③: maintainer-directed. A build card of ADR-0162, child of #36253.
Grade: area:data · Feature · n/a (not a defect) · reach: every console user of a declaring app · evidence: read (the two askers on `main` at `972114df`)
Suggested-grade: p2 · part of the feature #36253; without it the refusal is the user's first notice
Size: M (three console surfaces, one save path, their strings and tests).
Business reason: carried from #36253. A hidden button and a refused write should say the same thing, without each app spelling it out per object.
Reader: seat 2 (repo:objectstack#2), a card thread on `ui/**`, effort high.
Blocked-by: #37770 (item 2) (the read this card asks). The save-order change does not wait and can go first if the seat splits it out.
Clause-②: no. Console behaviour; no published contract moves.
Metadata-protocol: none
Dedupe: searched `getRecordLock` (open issues): #37195 concerns the record page's approvals part, which this card leaves as it is.
Related: #36253, PR #37606 (ADR-0162), #37231 and #37151 (the `lockSource` work the grid reads today), #37195.
